tasks.title: Define one value-owned relation application descriptor
tasks.purpose: Create the smallest canonical mathematical descriptor for exact forward/transpose application, reusing existing biological identities rather than canonizing a versioned operation enum.
implementation_steps: Use the supplied declaration sketch as a concrete starting point, not an ABI commitment. Keep source provenance, live buffers, stream, candidate, projections and mutable generations outside mathematical identity.
Retain typed source/destination domain-and-order identities, extents, topology ID/epoch, edge order/count, orientation and separate relation/input/multiply/accumulation/output types.
Define each logical edge as an additive contribution, including distinct duplicate endpoint edges. Empty rows sum to zero; transpose reverses traversal, not biological identities.
Specify overwrite and recognized-but-unsupported update/alias modes honestly. Describe topology reuse and exact support separately from floating-point equivalence.
acceptance: A minimal C++ compile verifies the descriptor is value-owned without self-referential pointers.
A non-square asymmetric fixture determines unambiguous input/result axes for both orientations.
No new generic graph system, blanket v2 migration, or physics-dependent identity is introduced.

invariants.rule: Only relation apply/transpose execute in this epic; N1 f16 weights/f32 arithmetic is the required witness. Full language, contraction execution, JIT, SDK and optimizer expansion remain deferred.
One canonical mathematical relation contract serves both origins. Source provenance and runtime value generations do not become topology identity.
Preserve valuable implementations and pre-existing user edits. Replace misleading semantics using counterexamples, not blanket version migrations.
Required accelerator gates run actual sm70 arithmetic and fail on unavailable hardware. Tolerances do not waive exact support, identity or explicit numerical contracts.
Serial queues within first-class Codex lanes; only genuine contract dependencies across lanes. Local-worker children are not lane substitutes.
Only integrator edits central build files. No leaf silently edits a peer contract; interface changes invalidate and notify consumers.
No active project-owned .ceh files remain after the scoped conversion. Preserve meaningful content as .cell; retain ordinary C++ .hh.
A test must execute the claimed computation. No name/grep/capability receipts substitute for runtime correctness; missing or deferred features remain explicit.

metadata.purpose: Serialize this epic’s final evidence only; execution must ALSO acquire the existing project GPU lease. Does not invent hardware inventory or exclude unrelated workloads by itself.
